description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司所属的指数列表。可按股票代码、日期进行筛选，返回指数名称、指数代码、指数来源（支持中证、国证、恒生指数、美指等指数公司来源）等数据。当用户想了解某A股属于哪些指数、分析指数成分股覆盖或查询某只股票被哪些指数纳入时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain a list of indices that an A-share stock belongs to. Filters can be applied by stock code and date, returning fields such as index name, stock code, and index source(support CSI, CNI, HSI, USI, and other indices companies). Call this interface when users want to know which indices an A-share belongs to (such as CSI 300, CSI 500, etc.) or query which indices include a specific stock.
